title: Security Middleware & Secure Configuration
objectives: Add rate limiting and body-size limits
Keep secrets out of code, logs, and binaries

examples.name: config.rs

exercise.prompt: Mark each as SAFE or LEAK: "secret read from env at boot", "secret logged in debug line", "secret baked into the binary", "CORS allowlist of two known origins", "CORS wildcard with credentials".
hints: Anything in logs or binaries is extractable.
Wildcard + credentials defeats the point of CORS.

questions.prompt: CORS is a browser mechanism to…
options: let servers opt specific origins into cross-origin reads
questions.explanation: CORS does not protect the server; it protects users’ browsers from unauthorized cross-origin reads.
Env/secret managers keep secrets out of code, artifacts, and logs.
